title: Pilot-wave management-plane sentinel swap playbook for private deployments
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Implement a repeatable, IaC-driven playbook to promote management-plane versions across VPC/private installs using pilot-wave promotion and sentinel probes. This ticket defines the Terraform module changes, preflight compatibility checks, runtime sentinel probes, and the swap mechanism that performs a zero-drift promotion of a new management-plane process while preserving tenant fencing and auditability. Expectations: 1) deterministic promotion steps codified in terraform modules and a small controller job, 2) telemetry-driven gating with quantitative pass/fail thresholds, 3) clear rollback hooks and tenant quarantine procedure.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module mgmt-promotion-v2 implements lease-based promotion and exposes plan-time dry-run output
Preflight checks run in CI and surface a compatibility matrix (CRD/schema, Etcd version, KV cache metadata)
Pilot-wave promotion can be executed in a test VPC with ≤3 minutes of disruption for non-control-plane traffic and zero redirection for tenant workloads
Sentinel probes (liveness, api-compat, auth, audit) report to Console and trigger automatic pause if a threshold breaches
Rollback is executable via a single terraform apply and all events are logged to the audit stream
engineering_notes: We use a lease-transfer model instead of immediate pivot to avoid double-writes on reconciliation loops
Promote workflow: prepare → dry-run plan → pilot-wave (5% hosts) → observability hold → wave expansion → final swap
Keep old binaries around for N+1 releases to allow fast rollbacks; images are tagged with sha+buildstamp
Rename controller binary to redwood-mgmt-promotion to make logs searchable across customer clusters
Controller will be deployed as a short-lived job managed by Terraform and reconciled by the customer operator during promotion window
implementation_steps: Design terraform module: modules/mgmt_promotion with inputs: target_version, pilot_fraction, sentinel_policy, dry_run
Add plan-time validation that enumerates node capabilities and compatible kernel/kernels selection hints
Implement promotion controller in Go: lease manager, sentinel runner (HTTP probes + schema checks), and swap executor
Integrate sentinel outputs to Console via telemetry export (metric names: mgmt.promotion.sentinel.*)
Add an action to the private controlplane CLI: redwoodctl mgmt promote --plan --execute
Author automated smoke-tests that run during pilot-wave (apiserver smoke, auth token exchange, basic CRUD on tenant resources)
rollout_plan: 1. Stage: dry-run in staging VPC and CI (no traffic impact). Verify terraform plan output and controller logs.
2. Pilot-wave: target 3 hosts in a non-critical customer-synthetic VPC; pilot_fraction=0.05
3. Hold: 30m telemetry hold window with automatic gating. Gate thresholds: error_rate < 0.25%, median latency delta < 25ms, audit drop rate = 0
4. Wave expansion: double pilot size every 30m until reach 50% then manual approval for final swap
5. Final swap: promote remaining nodes with 60m observation window and post-promotion health sweep
6. Postmortem: collect logs, export promotion trace, and publish to /confluence/private/promotion-runs
testing_plan: Unit tests for lease manager and sentinel rule engine
E2E: run promotion in a local kine/etcd cluster and assert resource reconciliation correctness
Chaos test: kill leader during wave expansion and validate automatic backoff behavior
Performance test: ensure promotion controller does not add >5% CPU to management-plane nodes during operation
Security test: verify that promotion controller only uses KMS-permitted keys and writes no plaintext secrets
